intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Tempo City has always danced to the tick of the Great Metronome, the clock tower in the middle of town.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Last night, the Metronome decided people were too messy. Now anyone who hears its tick turns into a rhythm robot who can only play ONE rhythm, forever.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Everyone is getting ticked. Everyone except Clap, whose rhythm is so bad the Metronome can't lock onto it.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Turns out "worst dancer in the city" is a superpower. Who knew?

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: Clap! I know how to wake people up! It's called an echo battle.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: A ticked person plays a rhythm. You copy it back, exactly. Break their loop, and they snap out of it.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Copy a rhythm. Me. The one with negative rhythm.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: That's why we're practicing first! I play a row, you play it back with the arrow keys or WASD. Wait for the count-in!

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: You did it! You're actually... kind of good at copying?

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: Okay. Wake everyone up, then march into that tower and shut the ticking off. Who's first?

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: The bus driver on Main Street. He's been stuck playing the same four beats since sunrise.

lose.speaker: Beats
lose.text: That's okay! Practice is for messing up. Again?

miss: Count with me: one, two, three, four...
streak: Whoa! Are you sure you're new at this?
Okay, now you're just showing off.
